nextmap_random_startup.description: Choose one random usable maplist.txt entry when the first live map is observed after plugin load.

nextmap_wait_for_round.description: Wait for round prestart or match end after the delay before rotating; false switches as soon as the delay expires.

nextmap_change_delay.description: Seconds after announcing a change. Rotation also waits for a round boundary when nextmap_wait_for_round=true; otherwise switches when this delay expires. Random startup uses only this delay.

nextmap_use_timelimit.description: Whether to auto-change the map when mp_timelimit elapses (in addition to mp_maxrounds).
